sources.title: Florida SB 264 - Medicaid doula coverage
sources.claim: Florida Medicaid covers doula services as of July 1, 2024 under SB 264, including prenatal, labor and delivery, and postpartum doula visits
sources.quote: Creates a Medicaid doula benefit; doulas certified by approved organizations may enroll as Medicaid providers and be reimbursed for prenatal, labor and delivery support, and postpartum visits
